title: The secret to easier exercise as an adult may start in childhood
caption:
Could your childhood activity levels be dictating how hard exercise feels today? A new study on guinea fowl suggests that early-life physical experiences can program your body for better movement efficiency in adulthood.

Source: Sciencedaily - The secret to easier exercise as an adult may start in childhood
